# `aitbc dispute auto-adjudicate`

Auto-resolve every dispute whose spot-check evidence proves a mismatch (S-3). Disputes without spot-check evidence are left for `aitbc dispute resolve`. Each auto-refund also slashes the provider bond, so one call can settle several payments.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dispute auto-adjudicate [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--yes` | flag | `false` | no | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dispute auto-adjudicate
```
